articles.summary: Human Interest, Retirement Industry Disruptor<sup>TM</sup> and the fastest growing 401(k) provider,<sup>1</sup> today announced the third generation of its embedded retirement technology platform, Human Interest Embedded Retirement (“Embedded Retirement”) that allows payroll providers, financial institutions, accountants, and other financial services providers to embed retirement plans into their products.
articles.title: Human Interest Unveils Third Generation of Human Interest Embedded Retirement, the Industry’s Leading White-Label 401(k) Platform

articles.summary: Human Interest, Retirement Industry Disruptor<sup>TM</sup>, today released a new report quantifying the massive impact that access to employer-sponsored retirement plans could have on more than 80 million hourly workers in America.<sup>1</sup> The findings reveal a dramatic and solvable gap: when hourly workers have access to a retirement plan, 82% participate and save; without access, 75% save nothing at all.
articles.title: New Human Interest Report Reveals The Power of Retirement Plan Access for Hourly Workers

articles.summary: Human Interest, Retirement Industry Disruptor<sup>TM</sup>, announced today that the company has earned a J.D. Power certification for delivering outstanding customer service phone support to 401(k) customers<sup>1</sup>. Human Interest continues its leadership within the industry by earning this prestigious certification as the company scales past 40,000 businesses served across the U.S.
articles.title: Human Interest Earns J.D. Power Certification for Outstanding Customer Service Experience for Phone Support
